thread:
nina: Heads upReleasebot suggested a patch for a small README tweak. Is that intended?

mike: Not ideal. We try not to bump for docs-only. We have a `skip-release` label and `/no-bump` command.

devrel_bot: releasebot scanned changed files: docs/**, examples/**, suggested bump: patch. To suppress: add label `skip-release` or comment `/no-bump`.

sam: Agree with mike. Add `meta: docs-only` to PR body so reviewers see intent. Also add a single line in internal changelog UI so PMs can find it later.

liu: For clarity: if the PR touches Dockerfile, build config, or API surface, treat as code and bump. Tiny site copy changes are fine to skip.

mike: For hotfixes: label `hotfix`, bump patch, pin the release, and run a 10% canary for 30m. Rollback = revert + deploy previous tag; we don't reuse semver numbers.

nina: Great, can someone add the snippet to the PR template?

sam: Will do, snippet: `meta: docs-only
labels: [skip-release]
release-notes: skip`. I'll also put the absolute rules in the release playbook.

mike: Thanks. One more: doc-only merges should still trigger a short release console entry with the PR link for audits.

devrel_bot: noted: audit entry queued.
